selectedAssets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite for an original isometric iOS real-time strategy game, Desert Frontline. Primary request: one premium detailed desert military command headquarters, isolated with genuine transparent alpha. Orthographic isometric three-quarter camera, looking down about 35 degrees; front and right walls visible, same angle as miniature RTS vehicles facing lower right. A coherent squat two-storey sand-colored reinforced command building, rooftop satellite dish, radio antennae, dark teal windows, inset double blast door, small attached generator and ventilation units, fine panel seams, subtle sand wear and realistic material highlights. Broad readable silhouette that remains clear at 100 pixels wide. Handcrafted high-quality 3D miniature render, not flat vector. Soft sunlight from upper left. Warm sandstone, olive steel, restrained cyan indicators. Entire building fits with 10% transparent margin, centered. No ground tile, no terrain, no sand base, no scenery, no cast shadow beyond the building footprint, no units, no people, no words, no labels, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. One building only. This is an original game asset, not a copy of an existing game building.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the provided war-factory image. Preserve the factory's exact architecture, camera, dimensions, colours, roof, two open bays, crane and every building detail. Remove only ALL surrounding brown glow, haze, shadow spill and background; every pixel outside the actual factory silhouette must have alpha zero. Output a clean precise game sprite cutout on genuine transparent alpha. Keep dark internal bay interiors intact; those are part of the factory. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no new content, no checkerboard painted in. Ensure a clear transparent margin around the entire building.
